title: Donate to Christopher Street Project (501c4)
text:
Trump and MAGA extremists are targeting the trans community with cruel policies designed to erase and oppress us. From banning healthcare to forcing schools to silence trans youth, they are making their agenda clear.

Christopher Street Project is responding with organizing, advocacy, and bold action. We are building the political power to hold Democrats accountable, stop Republican attacks, and defend the trans community at every turn.

Donate today to stand with us in this fight.

Supporting our 501(c)(4) organization helps fund critical operations and legislative work to fight for trans rights in Washington.
